1 (Currently amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a __non-destructive medium comprising water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a __cell wall degrading__ enzyme.

11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __________immature corn embryos.

12 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a __quiescent condition__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __PCR-based__ genotyping.

17 (Currently amended): The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on their __genotypic analysis__. 

19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is __performed using automation technology__.
